c.v: The signals for GP-SPI2 and GP-SPI3 are prefixed with "FSPI" (Fast SPI) and "SPI3", respectively.
FSPI bus signals are routed to GPIO pins via either GPIO matrix or IO MUX.
SPI3 bus signals are routed to GPIO pins via GPIO matrix only.
